messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a Python/TS SDK publish during the quiet window in 30m. Need a dist-tag lock + explicit yank safety policy for this cohort. Can we agree a publish checklist?
jin: +1. What's in scope: canary -> staged -> latest, signed wheels verification, npm dist-tag atomic flips.
sam: Any recent flakiness with wheel signing? Last time we had a mismatch with the mac build. If signing fails we should not flip any tags.
marie: Proposal: add a temporary 'staged' dist-tag and only promote to 'latest' after 2 successful smoke consumers (internal test apps). If anything fails we yank the staged tag and revert the publish. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: deploy_bot: initiating canary publish for @redwood/sdk-js@1.8.3-canary and @redwood/sdk-py==1.8.3rc1. Logs: publish started, push to registry queued.
alex: Good. Let's list the checklist items explicitly: 1) dryrun local publish test commands, 2) verify wheel signatures and checksums, 3) smoke test with internal app A and B, 4) dist-tag set to 'staged' initially, 5) promote to 'latest' and announce changelog + deprecation note.
jin: Dryrun commands: 
```
# npm dry-run (simulate)
npm pack && tar -tf redwood-sdk-*.tgz
# python build/test
python -m build --sdist --wheel && twine check dist/*
```
Use `twine check` and `gpg --verify` if signing enabled.
sam: If wheel signature mismatch occurs: do NOT promote tag. Open a hotfix thread, yank published artifact(s), and re-run signing pipeline. Who will trigger the yank if needed?
marie: I can be on yank duty for this window. Command we use: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk <tag>` and `pip index versions redwood-sdk` to confirm. We'll also remove package from internal prerelease index if necessary.
release-bot: deploy_bot: canary publish succeeded for JS (sha256:abc123), Python sdist/wheel produced (sha256:def456). Artifacts pushed to staging registry.
devex-oncall: Quick checklist for rollback criteria so SRE/Support can act: 
- failed consumers in both smoke apps within 15m of promote
- >1 error spike on tokenized endpoints immediately after promote
- checksum/signature mismatch reported by integrity job
If any of those, execute yank + force-roll to previous pinned release.
alex: Agree. Add: must notify #support and #product before final promote. Notify change log PR and deprecation note for sync client (sync APIs getting soft-deprecated next minor).
jin: For the tag flip we will use staged->latest atomic step: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.8.3 staged && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.8.3 latest && npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk 1.8.2` — do promote only after 2 green smoke checks.
sam: Also document the emergency revert sequence in the release post: exact commands, who is owner, expected ~10-20m to rollback. Keeps execs informed.
marie: I'll prep the deprecation blurb for changelog and the email template for customers. Drafting now, will push PR to docs -> link in channel when ready.
alex: Ok team, proceed with canary smoke. If you see anything odd ping me + @marie immediately. :eyes: 
release-bot: deploy_bot: smoke test app-A report: OK. app-B: OK. Awaiting promotion decision.
jin: Smoke checks green. Waiting 5m for final observability windows, then I'll promote.
sam: Observability shows no error spike, token latency normal. :thumbsup:
jin: Promoting now — flipping staged -> latest.
release-bot: deploy_bot: dist-tag update executed: staged->latest for @redwood/sdk@1.8.3. Promotion complete.
alex: Announcing deprecation note in changelog PR now and will post release notes after docs PR merges. Thanks everyone. :party:
__meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for release coordination: dist-tag lock, yank safety, publish window
